source_state: base plus R4 analysis files; exact offline files saved under results/r4_source_v1/analysis
timing: Batch execution.jsonl records in-entry wall time; results/r4_command_runs.jsonl records process wall time and observed OS peak working set. These are alternative timing views, not additive.
memory_measurement: Production: maximum recorded in-process graph timing peak. Other stages: actual research process queries in results/r4_{verification,analysis,derived}_process.json. The production command log observed_peak_working_set_bytes measures the small venv launcher only and is not used as research memory.
